verdict.rationale: Name.com exposes webhooks for domain/transfer/renewal events and an MCP server that lets AI agents call its API, plus built-in auto-renew, which are the building blocks for background automations. However, there's no evidence of a native scheduler, workflow/trigger engine, or persistent agent runtime — users must host their own webhook receiver or agent to actually run automations autonomously. Missing for 10: a documented autonomous execution/orchestration layer (not just webhooks+API), evidence of persistent background agent hosting, and independent confirmation these automations run unattended reliably.
